caps: How many times | should you walk | around *EACH GOD?*
lines.tts: How many times should you walk around each god?

caps: Most of us do | the *SAME* rounds | for every god.
lines.tts: Most of us do the same rounds for every god.

caps: But the scriptures | give each god | their *OWN NUMBER.*
lines.tts: But the scriptures give each god their own number.
For Devi, the Mother: just one round.

caps: For *SURYA,* the Sun: | *SEVEN,* | the most of all.
lines.tts: For Soorya, the Sun: seven, the most of all.

caps: Remember *PART 1?* | You never cross | the water from his shrine.
You walk up to it, | and *TURN BACK.*
lines.tts: Remember Part One? You never cross the water from his shrine. You walk up to it, and turn back.

caps: It's all in one verse | of the | *NARASIMHA PURANA.*
lines.tts: It's all in one verse of the Narasimha Puraana.

caps: Next temple visit, | *COUNT THEM* | with your child.
lines.tts: Next temple visit, count them with your child.

caps: How many rounds | do *YOU* do? | Comment | *YOUR NUMBER!*
lines.tts: How many rounds do you do? Comment your number!
